880-4488-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4488-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-2464-3249-5553.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3249-5553.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3249-5553.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

2150-2281-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

500-2523-6441-7824.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Bard and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Bard token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Bards dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Bard that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Bards you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.

475-1379-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-4017-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-2033-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1753-2033-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1753-2033-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-2034-4775.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

457-5159-5491-7297.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-7297.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2876-4050-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating  a token copy of Elenda that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {1}
When Elenda dies, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Vampire creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Vampires, adding {5}.
Repeat.

57-1251-2751-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1251-2751-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-5231-6972--112.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1483-5231-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1170-1329-3480-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

671-5073-5220-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Tinder Wall enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1263-4050-6277.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1661-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

678-4826-6644-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3372-4661-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vesuvan Doppelganger
3372-4661-5466.description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Vesuvan Doppelganger into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vesuvan Doppelganger's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Vesuvan Doppelganger's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

4185-4613-4968.description:
Activate Celestial Unicorn by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Celestial Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-3257-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-6528.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2100-3101-6259.manaNeeded: {R}{R}{R} minus {R} for each +1/+1 counter on Runaway Steam-Kin
2100-3101-6259.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Searing Touch.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with the persist creature

997-1856-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and the ability granted to it by Doom Weaver each trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Doom Weaver's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Doom Weaver trigger, repairing it and the persist creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1329-3169-4050-5491.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of artifacts equal to or greater than two plus Emry's commander tax.
1329-3169-4050-5491.description:
Cast Emry from the command zone by paying {U}.
When Emry enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Emry trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token and a Map token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emry, adding {U}.
Choose to return Emry to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

225-565-1809-1987.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1809-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Returned Pastcaller.
When the land and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, Returned Pastcaller and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1809-1987.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

372-1018-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1018-3378.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Skullwinder and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Skullwinder trigger.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Skullwinder and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

717-4067-5231-5458.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
An opponent controls a targetable artifact, land or creature.
717-4067-5231-5458.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, targeting an artifact, land or creature an opponent controls.
Marchesa and Bone Miser trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, either adding {B}{B}, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token, or causing you to draw a card.
If you created a Zombie token and your mana pool is empty, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
If you drew a card and your mana pool is empty, activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, targeting any permanent you control, triggering Bone Miser.
Repeat from step 3 until you have resolved all Bone Miser triggers and have at least {1} available.
Resolve the Marchesa trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to look at the top two cards of your library and put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
Repeat.

313-914-5256.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
313-914-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

513-1031-4872.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning up to one nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Time Warp and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

265-2034-4559-4871.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have a combined mana value of ten or greater.
265-2034-4559-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metlwork Colossus dies, Sly Requisitioner and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Sly Requisitioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Servo and the Treasure token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

656-1456-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

654-1257-3478-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Walking Atlas.
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
654-1257-3478-3525.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Amulet of Vigor.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

92-3779-4658.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest lifetotal or are tied for the highest life total.
92-3779-4658.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life when you gain life this turn.
Cast Swords to Plowshares by paying {W}, exiling Soul of Eternity and gaining life equal to its power.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1247-1323-3181-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1247-1323-3181-4893.description:
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pili-Pala.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Krosan Restorer.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {1} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Krosan Restorer's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 5.

16-3955.description:
Activate Lavaclaw Reaches's last ability by paying {1}{B}{R}, causing it to become a 2/2 Elemental creature with a new ability until end of turn.
Activate that new ability by paying {0}.
Ceaseless Searblades triggers, getting +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Lavaclaw Reaches's ability, having no effect.
Repeat from step 2.
